plugins.name: stintwell-law-firms
plugins.description: Stintwell for Law Firms: finds the one thing holding the firm back and gets you acting on it, across cash, marketing, intake, operations, hiring and AI. Not legal advice.

skills.name: controlling-law-firm-cash
skills.description: Cash, owner pay and trust-account hygiene for a law firm. Use when the owner asks how much to pay themselves, why revenue is up but cash is tight, how to build a 13-week cash forecast, how to separate profit, pay, tax and expenses, or anything about the trust account, retainers, settlements or moving money out of trust. Supplies no figures and sets no allocation shares.
skills.description_zh: 指导律所现金、所有者薪酬及信托账户管理，涵盖十三周预测和利润薪酬税费用区分。不提供数字或分配比例。

skills.name: converting-law-firm-intake
skills.description: Intake, follow-up and paying intake staff for a law firm. Use when the owner asks about missed calls, slow callbacks, consults that do not sign, hiring or paying an intake person, bonuses or commissions for non-lawyers, follow-up sequences, or after-hours coverage. Asks the state before any answer that turns on a rule, and supplies no conversion rates or response-time targets. Business of law only; not legal advice.
skills.description_zh: 指导律所咨询接待、跟进及员工薪酬，处理漏接、回拨、签约、非律师奖金和下班覆盖。涉及州规则先询问州，不提供转化或响应目标，仅讨论经营而非法律意见。

skills.name: enabling-law-firm-ai
skills.description: Where artificial intelligence fits in a law firm and where it must not. Use when the owner asks about using AI or a bot to answer phones, draft documents, chase leads, summarize files or automate anything, about connecting email, calendar or Drive so the AI can schedule, remind and draft for them, or which tools can hold client data. Decides no-model, co-pilot, supervised agent or human-only, and runs a data gate before any pilot. Business of law only; not legal advice.
skills.description_zh: 判断律所 AI 适合不使用模型、辅助、受监督智能体或仅人工，涵盖电话、起草、线索、资料摘要、邮箱日历和客户数据工具，试点前进行数据关卡。仅讨论律所经营。

skills.name: finding-law-firm-bottlenecks
skills.description: Starting point for a law firm owner who asks where to start, what is broken, or what to fix first. Use when the owner says they are stuck, drowning or plateaued, or asks which of money, marketing, intake, production, people or artificial intelligence to work on. Asks up to three questions, checks the stop conditions, names one bottleneck, and hands off to one role skill. Supplies no numbers. Business of law only; not legal advice. Also use when the owner asks what a client's case is worth, what a judge or jury would do, asks for a document or legal work for a client (a will, an agreement, a pleading), or anything else about a client's matter; this skill declines it and turns to the business side. Also use when the owner asks what a state's rules allow or require, whether a fee is earned or where client money may go, whether the firm may pay anyone for referrals, leads or signed cases, or what to write to the bar or a regulator; this skill hands those to ethics counsel and answers the business side.
skills.description_zh: 通过最多三个问题检查停止条件、识别一个律所经营瓶颈并分流专项技能，不提供数字。客户案件法律工作不处理，州规则、费用归属、信托资金和推荐付费问题交给伦理法律顾问，转向经营侧。

skills.name: leading-law-firm-growth
skills.description: The owner's job: goals, the seven-part firm score, org design, and what to stop doing. Use when the owner says they are the bottleneck, cannot get out of production, wants a plan for the next 90 days or five years, or asks whom to hire next or which clients to stop taking. Supplies no numbers; the firm's targets come from its own last twelve months. Business of law only; not legal advice.
skills.description_zh: 指导律所所有者目标、七项评分、组织及停止事项，支持九十天和长期计划、招聘和客户选择。目标来自本所过去十二个月，不提供外部数字或法律意见。

skills.name: marketing-law-firm-demand
skills.description: Getting the right cases in the door. Use when the owner asks about ads, Google, referrals, a website or video, what marketing costs per signed case, whether an agency is worth it, or why leads do not become clients. Supplies no cost figures or conversion rates; the firm's numbers come from its own invoices and its own signed matters. Every claim, testimonial and outreach line goes through a lawyer-signed review before it is published. Business of law only; not legal advice.
skills.description_zh: 指导律所广告、搜索、推荐、网站视频及签约成本分析，数字来自本所发票和签约案件，不给通用成本转化率。所有主张、推荐语和外联须律师签署审查后发布。

skills.name: operating-law-firm-systems
skills.description: How the work gets done: written procedures, a work-in-progress board, capacity, hiring order, and billing leaks. Use when the owner asks about deadlines slipping, files stalling, whom to hire next, writing procedures, or why billed hours do not become cash. Supplies no rates, hour targets or capacity ratios; the firm's capacity number comes from its own last twelve months. Business of law only; not legal advice.
skills.description_zh: 指导律所书面程序、在制看板、容量、招聘顺序和计费流失，处理期限延误及已计工时未变现金。容量依据本所十二个月，不给通用费率工时目标或比例。
